package.name: enc_updater
package.description: Cron-friendly NOAA ENC chart updater (ADR-0010 D7, the unh_marine_autonomy ADR): keeps an ENC corpus current and regenerates the bathymetry store's chart layer wholesale on change, with an enforced nav-down interlock. Offline tooling; never part of the ROS runtime.
package.author: Roland Arsenault
